title: Dorio in Solomon Islands Profile - test.joshuaproject.net
text: Introduction / History The Dorio are an indigenous Austronesian-speaking people living in west-central Malaita in the Solomon Islands. Their Dori'o language belongs to the Oceanic branch and is used in daily life. Historically, they share in the broader Malaita cultural patterns shaped by clan identity, subsistence living, and later contact with Christian missions during the colonial era.
